result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on the food delivery app screen, ranging from a truncated restaurant name to partially clipped UI elements in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is abruptly cut off in the 'Fastest near you' section without a visible ellipsis or proper truncation indicator, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or limit the card width so the truncation is visually clear (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccolo...'). Alternatively, wrap or resize the text to fit the card.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is partially clipped at the screen edge. While this can be intentional to hint at scrollability, the image crop looks abrupt and unpolished with no visual affordance (e.g., gradient fade) to indicate scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade on the right edge of the carousel or ensure the partial card peek is more consistently sized to clearly communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The category filter pill on the far right ('Healthy') is partially clipped, similar to the carousel. No visual indicator (e.g., fade or scroll arrow) communicates that more categories exist beyond the visible area.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade or a scroll indicator arrow to signal that the filter row is horizontally scrollable.
